turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clearer if you face me and talk slowly.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I brought her in today. She has been uneasy about her chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What can I help you with today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not felt right lately, my chest is bothering me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What does the pain feel like?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is a tight squeezing feeling in the middle.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does the pain spread anywhere, like your arm or jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, it goes down my left arm a little.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, walking up the hill makes it come on.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have trouble breathing with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, my breathing is fine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you break out in a sweat with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I do not sweat.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I felt dizzy once earlier this week.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does heart disease run in your family?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My father had a heart attack in his fifties.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure, and I have diabetes. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever had a heart procedure, like a stent or bypass surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I had a stent placed in one of my heart arteries.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me your daily medicines?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel, Lisinopril and Metformin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, let me go over the plan. First, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Second, call 911 if the pain gets worse or does not stop. Third, see the heart specialist within two weeks. Can you tell me back what the plan is, so I know I was clear?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will get the heart tracing and the blood test today, call 911 if the pain gets worse or will not stop and see the heart specialist in two weeks.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I will make sure she follows the plan.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any other questions?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I am scared this could be a heart attack. Is that what this is?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
